strokeOrder: draw the detached upright straight down — then lift once
set the pen low on the left and climb the tall body
without lifting, carry the top bar right and return to the inner upright
without lifting, descend into the rounded inner turn
without lifting, carry the low bar to the right
without lifting, return along the low bar to the left and finish up the inner stem — and only now lift
strokeOrderNote: two strokes — the detached upright, one pen lift, then five joined body movements; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I, Frame 2, ங

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 2, ங (University of Texas at Austin), p. 191
strokeOrderSource.variation: Appendix I Frame 2 numbers a detached descending upright before five joined movements build ங's framed and returning body. The bundled Noto Sans Tamil face places that detached upright on the right and squares the handwritten lower return; Tamil handwriting varies by school, so this is one attested two-run order fitted to the font rather than a national standard.

notes: Nga is the nasal partner of க: it supplies the ṅ sound in clusters such as ங்க. Frame 2's two pen-down runs survive the font fit even though the detached upright moves from the handwritten model's left edge to Noto Sans Tamil's right edge.
